detailed_descriptions.en: Hello, Starseekers! We're Mosscat, a two-person indie development team. We're excited to bring you this fast-paced action roguelike game! Keep upgrading and customizing your equipment and skills as you fight. Mix and match 8 unique weapons, 8 skills, and 120 weapon modules. Strategically purchase special items and deliberately sacrifice stats you don't need. Play to your strengths, work around your weaknesses, and create a combat style that's truly your own! Take on 25 stages, 25 types of monsters, and 7 powerful bosses! Capture all kinds of creatures you encounter in battle and put their abilities to good use. Pick the best specimens and bring them back to your base to build a ranch, where they'll continuously produce valuable materials for you. (Even while you're away!) Use resources produced by your ranch creatures to strengthen yourself. Absorb the essence of all things and combine 121 unique items to transform yourself from the inside out. Every essence you absorb brings you one step closer to an even more powerful form!
